Question ID: c03ee93c
Assessment Test Domain Skill Difficulty
PSAT 8/9 Math Problem-Solving and Data Analysis One-variable data: Distributions and measures of center and spread Hard
Question
The frequency table summarizes the distribution of a data set. What is the maximum value of the data set?
Correct Answer: 14
Rationale
The correct answer is 14. The table displays values from 6 to 14, so the maximum is 14.
